author: halfrest
body:
When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network please include the following: 
  • Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed)
Originally EnderCaticol, then Caticol, now SteinHD.

  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
Hacking/KillAura

  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
I have many friends and enemies on this server that I really miss playing with, and I don't want to lose my progress of XP on Nebula. I was a 1st Prestige. I sincerely apologize for what I did and I assure you I will not do it again. My friend introduced me to hacked clients and I got carried away, but I have recently deleted all the profiles. You can check my Youtube channel, TheEnderDen (recently changed to SteinHD), and I have no signs of any hacking whatsoever. I am clean and I want to come back. My hacking was very unfair to other players and I believe I have waited enough time to return. 

Any post that does not follow this guideline will be automatically locked. Also try not to spam us with 1000 appeals either. It doesn't help.

There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false?
It was half way. I was hacking at the time but I immediately gave it up after because of viruses and because I wanted to get unbanned.

  • Do i have any evidence to show the staff if was false?
Check my youtube channel, there is no sign of me hacking, and you can see I have skill with PvP developed over Avicus after 2 years of playing.

  • Have i waited long enough to be un-banned?
I have waited 4 months. Since January 8th, 2015

  • Have i been caught ban evading?
No.

  • Have i appealed a ban before?
This is my first, and only ban (hopefully).

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Seeing how you served this punishment for four months and made no attempt to evade it i shall lift this punishment.

This will be your last chance. Get caught hacking again and you'll be banned forever.

Please read the rules before you log onto the server.
